channel.title: Central African Republic - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Central African Republic, every source cited.

item.title: Central African Republic leader uses new constitution for life term
item.description: President Touadéra's March 30, 2026 inauguration solidifies his grip on power, resetting previous mandates.

item.title: Central African Republic ranks 50th out of 54 African nations in governance index
item.description: The country scores 31.3 out of 100, falling below the continental average and showing a decline in key areas.

item.title: Central African Republic fuel shortage continues
item.description: Long queues persist at Bangui petrol stations, disrupting daily life and commerce.

item.title: China trains Central African peacekeepers
item.description: Police and gendarmes from Bangui attend a global security seminar at Renmin University.

item.title: FAFECA opens digital hub for women entrepreneurs
item.description: The new center in Bangui aims to connect women to online sales platforms and the digital economy.
